about.bio1: I'm Arslan Titerbayev — a Full Stack Developer specializing in building modern websites, Telegram bots, and applications. I focus on clean code, smooth user experience, and high performance.
about.bio2: Over 1 year of learning and hands-on practice, I've built 20+ projects, mastered 15+ modern technologies, and delivered real solutions for 10+ satisfied clients.

nexclutch.title: NEXCLUTCH
nexclutch.description: Web & Desktop application for PC optimization, FPS boosting, and real-time hardware monitoring for CS2 players.
nexclutch.longDescription: NEXCLUTCH is a powerful platform and desktop app built for Counter-Strike 2 gamers. It offers ready-to-use pro configurations, sensitivity & crosshair presets, PC performance optimizations for higher FPS and zero lag, plus live CPU/GPU/RAM hardware tracking.

noutusta.title: NoutUsta
noutusta.description: A fast, trustworthy landing site for a laptop repair service in Tashkent, with online booking.
noutusta.longDescription: NoutUsta is a multilingual (Uzbek, Russian, English) website built for a laptop repair business in Tashkent. It includes a services catalog, customer reviews, and a repair-process gallery.

bugsense.title: BugSense
bugsense.description: An intelligent AI assistant bot for developers that finds bugs, explains errors, and optimizes code in seconds.
bugsense.longDescription: BugSense is a Telegram-based AI assistant that detects bugs and vulnerabilities in your code, explains them in plain language, and suggests ready-to-use fixes.

mortisai.title: MortisAI
mortisai.description: A multi-functional AI assistant bot that answers questions, writes content, and analyzes images.
mortisai.longDescription: MortisAI is a multi-functional Telegram AI assistant that gives accurate answers, writes content, understands images and voice messages, and chats in multiple languages.

coddyinsta.title: CoddyInstaBot
coddyinsta.description: Telegram bot for downloading Instagram and YouTube videos in HD quality and finding music.
coddyinsta.longDescription: CoddyInstaBot is a fast Telegram bot for downloading Instagram videos, Reels, and YouTube videos in HD quality, as well as searching for music.

coddycompiler.title: CoddyCompiler
coddycompiler.description: Online compiler for running and testing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript projects directly in the browser.
coddycompiler.longDescription: CoddyCompiler is a real-time interactive online compiler platform for writing, previewing, and testing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code instantly in your browser.

mwpizzashop.title: Pizza Shop
mwpizzashop.description: A modern e-commerce website for online pizza ordering and delivery.
mwpizzashop.longDescription: Pizza Shop is a sleek web application for ordering pizza online, featuring smooth cart management and instant checkout.

coddyreminder.title: CoddyReminder
coddyreminder.description: A Telegram bot that schedules and sends reminders in personal chats and groups at specific dates and times.
coddyreminder.longDescription: CoddyReminder is a smart Telegram bot for setting automated reminders for specific dates, hours, and minutes in personal or group Telegram chats.

testimonials.title: What people say.
testimonials.description: Feedback from founders and product leads I've partnered with.

test1.content: Arslan is the rare engineer who obsesses over both architecture and pixel-level polish. Our AI features shipped faster and felt more premium than anything we'd built before.

test2.content: Working with Arslan felt like adding a senior architect and a designer at the same time. Communication was excellent and the final product exceeded expectations.

test3.content: The real-time dashboard Arslan built handles millions of events without breaking a sweat, and it still looks like something out of an Awwwards showcase.

test4.content: Rare to find someone who can translate a design file into motion this faithfully. Every micro-interaction shipped exactly as envisioned.
